newsitem.title: URUGUAY: Uruguayan April inflation 1.42 pct - official.
newsitem.headline: Uruguayan April inflation 1.42 pct - official.

text.p: Uruguayan consumer prices rose 1.42 percent in April, up from 1.28 percent in March but down from 2.85 in April 1996, the Statistics Institute said Tuesday.
April's inflation took the price increase in the first four months of 1997 to 6.50 percent against 8.54 in the same period last year.
In the 12 months to April 1997 consumer prices rose 22.00 percent -- the lowest level since 1982. In the year finished in April 1996 inflation was 30.56 percent, the Institute said.
April consumer prices were boosted by increases of 2.1 percent in clothing and footwear, 1.9 percent in medical services and 1.6 percent in housing.
